scope: html/presenter.html -> src/presenter.tsx: the header, the Document List (documents and lyrics), the Presenting Flow List and its preview, the previewer (slides, stages, stage style, slide notes, the editing toolbar), the Presenter's Bible pane, the Bible Lookup popup's presenting jobs, the Bibles and Bible Notes lists, Background (colours, images, videos, cameras, webs, audios), every Foreground component's floating panel, the Mini Screen (screen cards, drawing and focusing, the Virtual Screens Manager, Bible/LongText Properties), Presenting Control, the tips card and the native menus as the Presenter shows them. The lookup popup's study tools are the Reader's inventory; Settings, the editors, the note window and the AI windows are other windows'. A row or menu shared by several lists (Rename, Duplicate, Move up...) is one item: the app draws it from one component and it does the same job in each list. Destructive rows are items, counted and never acted.

ignore.reason: a passage reference such as (KJV) John 3:16: the person's own history, saved lists and views, not a control's name
a saved passage row named by its reference: the person's own data
a warning badge on a saved row, not a control
a chapter button's number or a count: the chapter buttons are one item (pick-chapter)
a folder row showing its path: the person's own folders
words of a passage in a script that is not Latin (a name link in the text): data
the Khmer Bible installed here, on its version chip: data
a cross-reference row: a verse reference and its text, data (the rows are one item, open-verse-link)
the Font Size value beside its slider
a caution sentence under AI cross references
a file name in a list, a tile or a row: the person's own files

a name that starts in lower case: the person's own document, folder, note and file names, and the colour and transition values a picker lists (each picker is its own item; no control's name starts in lower case)
a slider's value beside it
a row of the All tips list (its number, title, category and detail) or a slide card's number and name: data, not a control
a slide card's number and name: the person's own slides (presenting one is slides-present)
a slide card's index badge
a slide's size, shown on its card
a presenting flow's step row: its kind and the person's own content (the rows are run from flow-preview)
a screen's number on its card or tile (the screens are the Mini Screen's and Screen Show's items)
a screen card read whole: its clear chips, display chip and footer, each its own item
a screen's display chip, read with its display id (screen-display)
a display of this computer, listed in the display chooser: data
a camera this computer has, listed by its device name: data (the tiles are fg-camera and bg-cameras)
a note row: its title (the person's own) and the hint (notes-open)
a note row's open title: the person's own note name (notes-open)
a note's verse row: its reference and text, data (notes-verse-drag)
a section of the chosen lyric: its number, name and words, the person's own song
a colour's value beside its swatch
a colour's value on a swatch
a slide's note heading, by slide number (slide-note)
